title: Power Quality Disturbance Recorder Pakistan 2026 — Voltage Sag, Swell & Interruption Logging, IEC 61000-4-30 Class A/S, WAPDA Tariff Penalty Evidence & SCADA Integration | Buyer's Guide
summary_html: Complete buyer's guide to power quality disturbance recorders (PQDR) in Pakistan 2026. Covers IEC 61000-4-30 Class A vs Class S, voltage sag/swell/interruption logging, WAPDA tariff penalty dispute methodology, SARFI indices, COMTRADE waveform capture, SCADA/IIoT integration via Modbus TCP and IEC 61850, and ISO 50001 EMS data quality. Sector sizing tables (textile, cement, cold storage, hospital) and ROI calculator included.
